newsitem.title: USA: Louise's Potato Chips files Ch 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Louise's Potato Chips files Ch 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: Louise's Inc filed for Chapter 11 protection late Friday in U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
In court papers, the Shelbyville, Ky., maker of low-fat snack foods listed assets of $35.9 million and liabilities of $33.8 million.

The largest unsecured creditor is a Cigna Corp affiliate, Cigna Investments Inc of Hartford, which has a $24.7 million lien on certain license and technology of Louise's, according to the court papers.
TGTBT Ltd owns at least 20 percent of Louise's voting securities and Louise's owns at least 20 percent of Industrial Finance Corp, court papers stated.
Louise's products are marketed under its own brand and by private label manufacturers. No one at Louise's was available for comment.
